Collaborative Cross colors

CCcolors.Rd

A vector of 8 colors for use with the mouse Collaborative Cross and Diversity Outbreds.

Source

<https://csbio.unc.edu/CCstatus/index.py?run=AvailableLines.information>

Details

`CCorigcolors` (see <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/blob/main/R/CCcolors-data.R>) are the original eight colors for the Collaborative Cross founder strains. `CCcolors` are derived from the the Okabe-Ito color blind friendly palette in Wong (2011) Nature Methods doi:10.1038/nmeth.1618 .

Examples

data(CCcolors)
